capabilities: Lock and unlock individual notes with a vault-wide or per-note password
Permanently decrypt single notes, folders, selections, or the whole vault
Auto-lock notes on navigation, inactivity timeout, and quit
Detect and re-secure plaintext left on disk after a crash
Show a status-bar count of currently unlocked notes
extras: README includes a security-model section: no password recovery, plaintext may persist on disk after crashes, and a round-trip verification step roughly doubles lock time.
motivation: Forked from danzar/Obsidian-Locker to continue and extend its encryption-at-rest approach.
problem: Obsidian stores note contents as plain Markdown on disk, so sensitive notes are readable to anything that touches the vault files.

relations.evidence: Track pre-release builds by adding the repository in the BRAT plugin.

summary: Note-encryption plugin that locks note bodies with AES-GCM at rest while keeping filenames and links visible.
